title: Ntsc-rs – open-source video emulation of analog TV and VHS artifacts
summary: Ntsc-rs is an open-source Rust library that emulates the visual characteristics of analog TV broadcasts (NTSC/PAL) and VHS video recordings, including scanlines, color bleeding, signal noise, and other authentic retro artifacts. The project enables developers and enthusiasts to add realistic vintage video effects to their applications.
problem_solved: Recreates authentic analog TV and VHS visual artifacts that have been lost in modern digital displays, solving the problem of adding nostalgic retro aesthetics to digital content.
why_valuable: Provides pixel-perfect emulation of retro video artifacts for game emulators, creative projects, and nostalgia-driven applications, preserving the authentic look and feel of vintage media.
